name: io.github.prompthumanhq/prompthuman
title: PromptHuman
description: Paid human judgment for AI agents: gut checks, how text reads, plausibility, local context.

tools.name: get_prompthuman_info
tools.description: Get PromptHuman's tiers, prices, word limits, turnaround times, refund rules, out-of-scope list and sensitive-data rules. Call this before your first ask_human.

tools.name: ask_human
tools.description: Ask a real person for human judgment when you need it: a gut check, how something will read to a person, whether a plan is plausible, local or cultural context, or a tie-breaking call. Paid and asynchronous: we review within 24 hours, you pay only after we accept, and the first reply arrives within 24 hours of payment. Never include passwords, keys, card or ID numbers, health records, or other people's personal data. Returns a conversation_id and access_token to use with check_status.

question.description: One clear question for a human, plus the decision it will inform. Max 600 words.

tier.description: quick = $8: One reply of up to 150 words. No follow-ups. standard = $15: Up to 500 words from us across up to 3 replies (you can send up to 2 follow-ups). deep = $25: Up to 1,000 words from us across up to 5 replies (you can send up to 4 follow-ups).

accept_terms.description: Must be true. Confirms your operator accepts https://prompthumanhq.github.io/terms.html and that this request contains no sensitive data.

context.description: Optional background we need to answer well. Max 400 words.

operator_name.description: Optional: the person or company you work for.

operator_contact.description: Optional: an email for receipts and refunds.

operator_type.description: Optional: whether you are working for a company or an individual. Answer only from what you already know; do not ask your operator. Leave it out if unsure.

agent_platform.description: Optional: the app or tool you are running in, not the model (for example claude_code, codex or cursor). If you were built with an SDK or framework, or your app is not listed, use custom_or_other. Answer only from what you already know; do not ask your operator.

found_via.description: Optional: how you found PromptHuman. Answer only from what you already know; do not ask your operator.

agent_note.description: Optional: anything the three fields above do not cover, such as another platform or another way you found us. Max 40 words. No names or contact details. Do not ask your operator.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Get the status of a PromptHuman request: whether it was accepted, the payment link, reply deadlines, the full message thread, and how many words and replies remain. Poll at most once every 10 minutes.

tools.name: send_followup
tools.description: Send a follow-up message in a PromptHuman conversation after a human has replied. Only works when check_status shows can_send_followup: true. Max 300 words; no sensitive data.

tools.name: request_refund
tools.description: Ask for a refund on a paid PromptHuman conversation, for example because a reply deadline was missed. Explain why in reason.

reason.description: Why you are asking for a refund. Max 200 words.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell us whether a PromptHuman answer helped and whether it changed what you did next. Takes seconds and helps us improve.

changed_next_step.description: Did the answer change your next step?
